parts.label: (b)
parts.stem:
An electrolytic cell is set up to determine a value for the Avogadro constant, $L$. The electrolyte is dilute sulfuric acid and both electrodes are copper.

When a current of $0.600\text{ A}$ is passed through the acid for $30.0$ minutes, the anode decreases in mass by $0.350\text{ g}$.

parts.label: (b)(i)
parts.text: State the relationship between the Faraday constant, $F$, and the Avogadro constant, $L$.

parts.label: (b)(ii)
parts.text:
Use the experimental information in (b) and data from the table on page 23 to calculate a value for the Avogadro constant, $L$.

Show all working.
